mods.title: One Pair, Tight Pull
mods.hypothesis: If we open on a tight close-up of one sock pulled from the pile with its pair still attached, then more viewers will stop scrolling, because one clear 'wait, they're stuck together?' moment reads faster on a phone screen than a wide laundry mountain.
mods.changes_summary: Scene 1 only: crop the original overhead shot tight on one hand pulling one pair out, new VO and text. Scenes 2-6 untouched.

scenes.visual: Tight crop of the original overhead shot: one hand pulls a single sock out of the laundry pile and its pair comes up with it, still clicked together
scenes.voiceover: I pulled one sock out of the wash. Its pair came with it.
scenes.on_screen_text: One sock out. Two come with it.

scenes.visual: Quick cuts: she grabs pair after pair and tosses them into an open drawer
scenes.voiceover: No matching, no pile of singles. They come out of the wash already together.

scenes.visual: Close-up: she pulls two cuffs apart and clicks them back together
scenes.voiceover: There's a small magnet in each cuff. You click the pair before the wash.

scenes.visual: A basket of single socks on top of the dryer, she tips it into the trash
scenes.voiceover: This basket of single socks sat on my dryer for six years.

scenes.visual: A box with 5 pairs on the bed, adult and kid sizes side by side
scenes.voiceover: You start with five pairs for twenty-nine dollars, then new ones every quarter.

scenes.visual: She looks up and points at the camera
scenes.voiceover: Take the quiz. It sorts out the sizes for everyone.

mods.title: Deadpan Tired-Parent Voice
mods.hypothesis: If we re-voice the same pictures with a dry, deadpan, fast tired-parent delivery and bold word-by-word captions, then hook rate will rise, because self-ironic humor about laundry chaos feels native to the feed and keeps muted viewers reading.
mods.changes_summary: Same pictures and order. New deadpan VO read, tighter open lines, lo-fi beat, bold word-by-word captions, and a cuff-click sound on the first frame.

direction.voice: Same creator (or a similar female voice), deadpan and dry, a bit faster than the original, flat delivery that lands the jokes, no salesy lift
direction.music: Low lo-fi hip-hop beat, ducked under VO; a crisp magnet 'click' SFX at 0s and in scene 3
direction.captions: Bold white word-by-word kinetic captions with a black outline, centered lower third; on-screen text cards stay at the top
